description: Controller support for Minecraft 1.8.9 on Ornithe.

mods.name: Controlify
mods.description: Controller support for Minecraft: Java Edition.

releases.notes:
## Controller changes

- Uses upstream Controlify's default bindings, response curves, and SDL controller database. Existing remaps carry into the first controller profile. Use **Restore Upstream Defaults** in OneConfig to apply the upstream layout.
- Adds per-controller profiles and a picker for connected gamepads.
- Adds a hold-and-release radial menu, an on-screen chat keyboard using upstream's English layout, and hold-to-repeat hotbar and inventory navigation.
- Adds independent camera speeds, gyro calibration and activation options, and vibration effects for item use and nearby explosions.

## Install

Replace the previous Controlify JAR in your Minecraft 1.8.9 Ornithe Gen 2 instance's `mods` folder. Java 21 or newer is required. See the [backport README](https://github.com/ooTruffle/Controlify-Ornithe/blob/v3.5.5-legacy/README.md) for tested dependency versions.

The backport was tested in-game with two SDL virtual controllers for radial selection, chat shortcuts, hotbar repeat, and profile switching. Physical gyro and vibration testing is pending.

mods.description: Controller support for Minecraft: Java Edition.

releases.notes:
## Controller changes

- Remap gameplay and menu buttons in OneConfig. The controller guide follows your bindings.
- Adjust left and right stick deadzones independently. Both default to 18%.
- In inventories, use the D-pad to snap between slots and Y to quick-move a stack with the default layout.
- Damage triggers controller vibration. Use **Test Vibration** in OneConfig for a preview.

## Install

Put the release JAR in the `mods` folder of your Minecraft 1.8.9 Ornithe Gen 2 instance. Remove any older Controlify JAR from that instance before launching.

This build requires Java 21 or later. The Windows development client was verified with Java 25 and these dependency versions.

| Dependency | Tested version |
| --- | --- |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.5 |
| Ornithe Standard Libraries | 0.21.0 |
| Pylon | 0.2.9 |
| OneConfig | 1.9.3 |
| Fabric Language Kotlin | 1.14.1+kotlin.2.4.20 |
| PolyCompose | 3.0.5 |

Use PolyCompose 3.0.5 for this setup. The 1.8.9 build of 3.0.6 is missing a class used by notifications.
